steps.text: Set an oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source and preheat the oven’s broiler.

Heat oil and butter in a skillet over medium heat. Add chicken breasts; cook until no longer pink on the inside and golden brown on the outside, seasoning each side with Creole seasoning, about 10 minutes per side.
Scoop avocados into a bowl. Add tomato, onion, lime juice, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper; mash together.
Spoon about ⅓ cup guacamole onto each chicken breast, top with 1 slice pepper Jack cheese; broil until cheese is melted and bubbling, 2 to 4 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Guacamole Chicken Melt
raw_recipe.description: For this guacamole chicken melt recipe, seasoned chicken is browned, topped with homemade guacamole and slices of pepper Jack cheese, then broiled.

video.description: Add chips and salsa on the side, a salad, and you have a savory chicken dish that is different, appetizing and simple!

review.reviewBody: This was so easy and so delicious! I loved it, my family loved it! I didn't know what to think about putting guacamole on top of chicken, but then couldn't believe the wonderful flavor it added. I will be making this again and again!

I used chicken thighs instead and browned them in the IP on saute mode then pressure cooked them. Finished them in the toaster oven under the broiler. The wife who is on a low carb diet just went nuts over them. This will be added to my favorites.

This was delicious! I was able to reduce the calories down to 300 a serving by taking the 3 chicken breasts, I had, and cutting them in half and flattening them slightly with a knife. The smaller size helps them cook quicker anyhow, 5 minutes sauté per side. I also used a half slice of cheese on each, since they were a little smaller. For the creole seasoning, I used a recipe on Allrecipes which I made 1 serving of just for this. Clean-up was easy too. I lined a large baking sheet with foil and sprayed with PAM. Took only about 2 minutes to broil. Quick, tasty, and easy. Ty, will make again.
**Note - This does not re-heat well with the avocado on top. It is best fresh. So, I would just make enough for dinner or keep the avocado separate for lunches**

I baked the chicken breasts (cut 2 large breasts into 4 thinner pieces) at 350 for 30 minutes. I topped each piece with guacamole and mexican cheese then broiled it until the cheese melted. I served it with black beans, corn, and salsa. Yummy!

This was soooo good!! This dish is only as good as your guacamole. I prefer my gauc with sour cream and cream cheese. I used the recipe from this site "Easy Never Forgotten Guacamole", but added lime juice, chopped onions, cumin, cilantro, jalapeno pepper, substituted white pepper for black. The salsa in the guacamole came from this site, "The Best Fresh Tomato Salsa", just add minced garlic. Put your salsa in the fridge for 4 hours to let the flavors marry. Then add it to the guacamole. Yum! I will definitely be making this again.

I stuffed the chicken thighs with salsa, baked it at 425 for 10mins. Topped it with the guacamole and cheese and baked for another 10, then high broil for 2 to 3mins. 
Aaaamazing

I found this recipe by entering the ingredients in the search function. I can't cook with salt or butter, so I boiled the chicken breasts until done, sliced them in half long-wise, seasoned with some garlic powder and broiled with the guacamole and very thin-sliced pepperjack strips. I served with roasted, fresh beets (recipe also from this site) and it made a really tasty and pretty plate! I will definitely make this again.

I made this for the first time tonight in a cast iron skillet and was able to take it from stove top to broiler. I had no tomato and used chunky medium salsa instead. I also only had dried cilantro and used Cajun seasoning to taste. It was delicious!! My husband said, on a scale of 1-5, he’d give it a 9.5. Will definitely make it again and sharing it.

I loved the recipe, but I made some changes to enhance the heat and flavor. I added Hatch Valley Southwestern 505 Flame Roasted Green Chile to taste. I used Kroger Mexican Style Blend (4 cheeses) Shredded Cheese to top the guacamole and broiled it to perfection. My wife loved it and she's Italian. She is a green chilie and guacamole fan. So that's why we ate the whole three big chicken breast recipe ourselves!

Great recipe, I used shredded Mexican blend cheese because I had no pepper jack. I drizzled some Sriracha over the cheese to give it a little kick before I put it in the oven. I also put some sour cream on top before serving. Fantastic!

Substituted my own guac recipe and grilled the chicken on the Weber, but this was really great! First time I made it and was asked if I’d made it before because it was so good. It was requested to be made again!
I love this- VERY tasty. I made it with your recipe for Mexican Street Corn and Spanish rice. My wife liked it, and she doesn't like anything. This one goes in the rotaion.
Made for 6 people. Served with skillet Mexican street corn and refried beans. Even my wife, who doesn’t like spicy foods, wants to keep it in the rotation!
We absolutely love this recipe however, I use my own recipe for guacamole. Our oldest granddaughter wants it every year (and anytime I will fix it in between) for her birthday dinner.
This was amazing! To save time I mixed chunky salsa with the avocado, instead of the tomatoes, onions and garlic powder. My husband loved it.
Wasn't really sure about hot guacamole, but this was really good. Made it according to the directions. Personally, I like my chicken thinner so I will pound it out next time.

Outstanding! Super easy! We used one garlic clove in Lieu of the garlic powder and it was exceptional. Did not have pepper jack cheese so used shredded Mexican cheese. Would not change a thing! Will definitely make this again
This was absolutely delicious! I followed the recipe exactly except I added a clove if fresh garlic and cilantro to the guacamole. I served with a side of rice pilaf. Definitely will be making again!

I wasn’t too sure about hot guac so I reversed it and melted Muenster cheese on my chicken and guac on top! Paired it with an almond mango salad and detox water with cucumber and lemon! It was delicious!
Incredibly easy and delicious. A new family fav!
